0.description: In the game you are Mahi, who lives in a busy city where crime happens frequently. There you live as a transporter but you also have a hidden life. As Mahi you need to go do some work like transport cars and passengers and also you can drive a taxi as a side job. You will gain money from your work and can spend your earned money to buy food, guns, medicines and other items. But also when Mahi dons a mask he becomes MA3 who saves people from others and kills enemies such as kidnappers and bad people. When the public is disturbed the police will be on high alert and will target MA3.     In the Game you will be able to:  drive parked cars steal police cars, but will be targeted by the police hunt animals sword fights stealth kills swim run walk drive get different cars drive taxis jump and many more   If you die in the game you will need to play again from the last saved checkpoints or you can start a new game from the start too. If you enter the water with a car it will throw you out of the car into the water. Enemies can swim in the water but no one can fight or shoot inside the water.      If there are any errors or mistakes please give me your feedback to make changes for the next update of this game.    This is part 1 of MA3.    Thanks for your time and support.    Matheesan Paramagnanam
